care.summary: Fascinating plant with oval leaves that fold up at night like praying hands; known for striking vein patterns.
care.light: Bright indirect light; leaves fade in direct sun
care.water: Keep soil consistently moist but not soggy; use room-temperature water
care.soil: Well-draining, peat-based potting mix with perlite
care.humidity: High (60-80%); thrives with humidifier or pebble tray
care.fertilizer: Balanced liquid fertilizer every 2 weeks in growing season
common_issues: Brown leaf edges from low humidity or fluoride in tap water
Leaf curl from underwatering or cold drafts
tips: Use distilled or rainwater to prevent brown tips
Prune leggy stems to encourage fullness
